The decisive mistake was Fitness_Expert's step 3. It reported three gyms (Blink Fitness, TMPL, East Side Athletic Club) as found "using Google Maps and Yelp," but the script had produced no results and no search was actually run. Neither the correct answers (CrossFit East River, Avea Pilates) nor any verified candidates were in the search space, so every later schedule check examined the wrong gyms.
